910.name: Prehistoric Morocco

sub_clusters.name: Iberomaurusian and Capsian Cultures
sub_clusters.description: North African Upper Paleolithic; cave sites at Taforalt.

sub_clusters.name: Marinid Dynasty

940.name: European Colonisation
